scope: Selected full current-target comparisons with identified prior source variants, plus internal current-runtime comparisons. No claim of exhaustive human/native semantic uniqueness across7128. Historical variants are expressly identified rather than misrepresented as current counterparts.

records.causalTaskAndClosureReason: Rejected the shared-basket split-payment development. Final exchange addresses an owned strap trapped in a store cart, consent not to cut it, unloading, recovering the bag and handing the cart back; no allocation of payments.

Rejected the intermediate broken-basket handle version. Final snag belongs to the learner's bag, includes not cutting owned property and checking bag damage after release. It does not report missing basket parts or preserve eggs from a broken handle; the common safe-stop/unloading skill remains useful.

Rejected the mother's autonomy/companion-role version. Final learner is the patient, distinguishes intermittent pain from current absence, identifies unknown historical time and corrects an exaggerated constant-symptom form.

Rejected wrong-recipient mail/redirection. Final purpose is buying collectible stamps separately from posting needs, checking postage before separating unused display copies; no unknown recipient or redirection issue.

Rejected original-versus-copy document packing. Final learner mistakes a counter queue ticket for shipment tracking, corrects a premature family message, chooses a tracking-capable method and waits for the proper receipt.
Rejected cohabitation-versus-household certification. Final issue is an inaudible counter call, visible display position, changing information fields and matching the held ticket to the counter.

Rejected companion booking-change coordination. Final issue is a pedestrian transfer segment mistaken for in-train rest, outside-gate movement and selecting a route with luggage constraints rather than coordinating two reserved seats.

Rejected accident observation and inferred direction. Final learner reports repeated unwanted messages, retains received evidence, distinguishes their one reply, avoids publication and confrontational searching.
Rejected road-obstacle location reporting. Final exchange clarifies an accompanying language helper is not a witness and keeps the helper's guesses out of the learner's account.
Rejected the later unverified-noise-source complaint too. Current witness/helper-role exchange has no noise log, named-neighbour accusation, cause inference or apartment-manager complaint.

Prior case repairs a missing negative in the learner's own account after a door incident. Current case starts with who witnessed the event, limits a companion to language assistance and excludes their conjectures. Both teach checking unfamiliar record terms, but participant roles and state progression differ.

Rejected invalid correction on an enclosed document. Final case cancels shipping before acceptance after the sender changes to direct delivery, verifies the request and arranges family collection while keeping the parcel in hand.

Prior case interprets the found phone's displayed clock and a receipt as uncertain pickup time. Current case is whether to answer an incoming call or open contacts, declines to infer ownership from display names and delegates caller handling. Reporting a pickup time is routine context, not the five-task development.

Two-account address-update scope differs from two medical appointments: learner has submitted only one booking slip, may be called by the first department and needs an agreed order before moving. Shared checking of a second item is a common skill, not one causal script.

Prior case corrects unit price and selects one loose fruit. Current case rejects the assumption that equal package weight means equal count, needs one item per guest and selects a sealed package with enough pieces. Price conversion and loose-item selection are absent.
Alcohol refusal throughout a group meal and maintaining tea on later rounds differs from sushi plate/piece arithmetic and additional food quantity. Group ordering words do not determine either plot.

Prior learner remains for medication/cashier procedures after examination before returning to work. Current learner prematurely promised a discharge date to a distant family driver and must distinguish provisional date, time and later contact channel.

A family's sent-money message versus actual account receipt and separate origin/destination inquiries is unrelated to a government notice addressed to a wife. Family, pending confirmation and fact-only wording are shared language, not task equivalence.

Current learner specifies two fish portions rather than two whole fish, asks about remaining bones and chooses similar thickness for cooking. Prior case identifies discounted identical packages and separate receipt prices; no order-unit or preparation progression.

Current envelope contains a rigid accessory as well as paper and requires honest contents disclosure plus protection of accessory corners. Prior case starts with a no-fold submission condition for paper and chooses a larger envelope. Packaging is shared, but the classification error and object-specific handling differ.

Moving an inventory box into empty-box collection and identifying it without altering contents differs from taking another customer's paid shopping bag and matching a receipt to one's own identification tag.

A mistaken event gathering becomes a short-duration volunteering request and permission before using tools. The counterpart concerns unreadable medical exam terms and preparation questions. Common asking/awaiting words are the only connection.

An owner's decision not to have a keepsake book inscribed and separating two physical books differs from an application signature requiring the applicant to return and personally submit. Ownership consent is shared, while irreversibility, object management and final action differ.

Current temple case concerns permission to record a bell without strangers' speech or forbidden access and a verbal description if recording is unavailable. Counterpart concerns unrecorded egg allergy instructions on two food orders. Pending confirmation alone is not a script match.

Postponing frozen-item purchase because of an unprepared long outing, handing the item to staff and rescheduling purchase differs from mistaking an empty sample container for the sale product and comparing capacity.

Counter queue number mistaken for tracking is corrected before posting and before sharing a receipt. The prior source variant concerns identifying a government notice by reference number and checking required action; identifier use is shared, not the states or outcome.

Current route adds a destination outside the purchased segment after visiting a friend; learner separates existing travel from the next leg. Prior confusion is issue date versus travel date and avoiding duplicate purchase of the same trip.

Current lost-item photo accidentally contains a bystander's document and is cropped for presentation, with unseen initials described separately. Prior learner wants to avoid speaking their own confidential document identifiers publicly. Both respect privacy through distinct evidence and communication tasks.

Current learner mistakenly assumes a per-item shelf price is for the sealed multi-item pack and switches to one loose item without opening the pack. Prior learner weighs barcode-less produce, removes a non-food note and confirms the weighed price. No weighing process in the current story.

Medical result collection versus an unverified consultation booking concerns what appointment will happen and when to tell work. Prior case compares parcel numbers after a family member received a different parcel. Shared 'one thing does not complete another' skill is not an identical task chain.

An unchanged person's abbreviated everyday name differs from a legal surname change on an existing bank account, old signature and card handling. Current role is applicant clarifying a long name and further form fields, not authorising a registration change.

The current patient questions whether absent current pain makes attendance meaningless, distinguishes repeated episodes from constant symptoms and corrects the form. The peer explains limits of a dark historical symptom photo, avoids colour editing and combines unseen sensations with a time memo. Common accurate symptom chronology is useful without copying either five-task sequence.

Both initial drafts split payment and were rejected. Final Obama script reports a wet floor, requests a tray resting place and hands cleaning to staff. Final Fukui script releases an owned bag strap from a cart without cutting it and inspects the bag. Both replace the original payment plot completely.

Current proxy purchase cannot proceed because the father and his current medication details are unavailable. The other consults about old unidentified medicine, does not pass it to relatives and requests disposal guidance. Different starting authority, medication state, questions and final action; no clinical recommendations are invented.

Left-handed workshop positioning involves seeing the tool and keeping elbow clearance from neighbours, before practice. Crab-meal consultation limits help to difficult shell work due to hand pain while allowing the companion to eat first. Physical assistance is a shared real-life skill with different causal developments.
